 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR QUASHING & SET ASIDE  FIR/ORDER) NO. 11866 of 2022  ==========================================================

 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR MAHEK B. RAVAL FOR MR PREMAL S RACHH(3297) for the  Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5,6  MS KRUTI A PARMAR(11165) for the Respondent(s) No. 2  PRANAV DHAGAT APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

By way of preferring present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, the applicants - original accused persons seek to invoke the inherent powers of this Court,
praying to quash and set aside the First Information Report being C.R.No.11202001220024 of 2022 registered with the Mahila Police Station, Jamnagar for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 as well as all other consequential proceedings arising pursuant thereto.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11866/2022 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined 2.

Today, when the matter was called out, the respondent No.2 - original complainant was personally present before this Court and was identified by learned advocate Ms.Kruti Parmar appearing on behalf of the original complainant and also produced the affidavit, which is ordered to Ashish Jamanbhai Nakum vs State Of Gujarat on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68678105/
1 be taken on record.

sentences.text: In the said affidavit, the complainant has stated that the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled and in view of the said settlement, applicant No.1 and the original complainant have started residing separately.

When the Court asked the original complainant, who is present before the Court, regarding the said affidavit, she stated that she has signed the affidavit at her own will and without any threat or duress and she has no objection if the F.I.R. is quashed and set aside.

3. Considering the issue involved in the present application as well as considering the fact that the dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties, with the consent of the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, the present application is taken up for final disposal.

4. Heard learned advocate Mr.Mahek B. Raval appearing for Mr.Premal S. Rachh for the applicants,
learned A.P.P. NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11866/2022 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined
Mr.Pranav Dhagat for the respondent No.1 - State and learned advocate Ms.Kruti Parmar appearing for the respondent No.2 - original complainant.
5. The learned advocates for the respective parties stated that in the present case, the chargesheet has not yet been filed.
6. The complainant, who is personally present in the Court, has categorically stated that she has no objection if the application is allowed and the impugned F.I.R. is quashed and set-aside.

7. The relevant paragraphs of the affidavit of the complainant read as under:-
"1. That I am the First Informant / Respondent No. 2 who has lodged the FIR against the petitioners, which came to be registered at Mahila Police Station, Jamnagar, vide I-C.R. No. 11202001220024 of 2022 for the offence punishable u/s 498-A, 323, 504 and 114 of IPC and u/s. 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
I state that FIR is file and the charge sheet has not been filed yet before the learned JMFC Court.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11866/2022 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined 2.
I submit at the outset that I am filing this affidavit in favour of the petitioners as the dispute between us stands amicably settled and we have started residing separately.
In view of such settlement, I do not wish to proceed further with the FIR.
3. I further submit that the FIR in question was lodged by me due to disputes which have now been fully resolved.
Therefore, the present application filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of the said FIR may kindly be allowed, and the FIR may be quashed and set aside in view of the settlement.

4. I further submit that the petitioners have approached this Hon'ble Court under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking quashing of the FIR lodged by Ashish Jamanbhai Nakum vs State Of Gujarat on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68678105/
2 me.

sentences.text: I state that I have no objection if the FIR quashed on the ground of settlement.
Hence, I am filing this affidavit in support of the said petition.
5. I further submit that I am filing this affidavit voluntarily, of my own free will and volition, and without any coercion, undue influence, or pressure from any person.

I reiterate that I have no objection if the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11866/2022 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined present application is allowed and the FIR is quashed and set aside in view of the settlement.
6. I state that the contents of this affidavit are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and I state the same on solemn oath."

8. Having heard the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties as well as considering the facts and circumstances arising out of the present application and also taking into consideration the decisions rendered in the cases of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab, reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 31, Manoj Sharma Vs. State &
Ors., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 190, Narinder Singh & Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. reported in 2014 (2) Crime 67 (SC) and State of Haryana Vs. Bhajanlal reported in AIR 1992 SC 604, it appears that continuing further with the criminal proceedings in relation to the impugned FIR against the applicants - accused would be an unnecessary harassment NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11866/2022 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined to the applicants - accused.

Hence, to secure the ends of justice, the impugned FIR and all other consequential proceedings arising pursuant thereto are required to be quashed and set aside in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
9. In the result, the application is allowed.

The proceedings of the First Information Report being C.R.No.11202001220024 of 2022 registered with the Mahila Police Station, Jamnagar for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 as well as all other consequential proceedings arising pursuant thereto are hereby ordered to be quashed and set-aside qua the present applicants - original accused.
10. Rule is made absolute.
Interim relief granted earlier stands vacated.
Direct service is permitted.
